gesture.initial_pose: Both hands resting near the sides of the body at hip level

movement_sequence.action: Right hand begins elevating toward upper chest first, followed by left hand rising from hip.
Both hands enter the signing space in front of the center chest, palms facing each other/forward with fingers upright.
Both hands interact in front of chest with slight downward wringing/compression pulse and attentive head nod.
Both hands descend smoothly along the front torso back toward the hips.
Both hands return to bilateral neutral standby rest beside the hips.

gesture.finger_configuration: Fingers extended upright in flat B configuration on both hands, palms oriented inward/forward
gesture.facial_expression: Attentive, focused facial expression with subtle affirmative nod during chest interaction
